description:
The seismic monitoring network has been suffering from an elevated false-detection rate from the scautopick automatic phase picker. The cause has been identified as broadband cultural noise in the 1–4 Hz frequency band during daytime operations. The network operations team has approved the following parameter changes to scautopick to filter out this noise while preserving sensitivity to regional M≥3 earthquakes:

1. Set the waveform filter to: BW(4,4,20)  (4th-order Butterworth bandpass, 4–20 Hz)
2. Set the STA/LTA trigger-on threshold to: 3.5
3. Set the STA/LTA trigger-off threshold: 1.5
4. Set the AIC picker minimum SNR to: 2.0

Open scconfig, navigate to the Module Parameters section for scautopick, apply all four changes, and save/update the configuration so the new values are written to the scautopick configuration file.
